engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in a local Docker fixture
case: Server-inferred query parameter types for domain-over-enum list comparisons
added_coverage: A base-enum-cast domain column compared with IN ($1, $2) and NOT IN ($1, $2) infers each bound text parameter as the qualified enum type.
Exact per-row truth values include SQL NULL propagation; pg_typeof($1), pg_typeof($2) and pg_typeof(status) independently confirm both parameter and domain types.
The test remains alongside ordering comparisons, BETWEEN, equality/inequality, SQL NULL parameter inference and the explicit raw-domain equality refusal.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL 16 pg_typeof() results and exact row-level comparison values for an enum-backed domain including SQL NULL.

domain_contract_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
